name: Schema violation
description: Object does not conform to its frozen JSON Schema.

name: Content hash mismatch
description: Recomputed RFC 8785 + SHA-256 hash differs from the recorded object hash.

name: Status separation violation
description: semantic/authorization/physical/release statuses are collapsed into one field or omitted.

name: Post-freeze mutation
description: Attempt to modify an object whose release_status is frozen, released or invalidated.

name: Invalid release transition
description: Release-status transition not in the frozen transition table.

name: Unknown reason code
description: A transition or adjudication used a reason code missing from the catalog.

name: Unsupported inference
description: A coded proposition is not permitted by its inference-matrix row.

name: Entailment failure
description: Query or Contract adds an obligation or omits a responsibility clause.

name: Gold action in Contract
description: A Contract formula prescribes an action sequence rather than an evaluator-relevant condition.

name: Semantics not frozen before scan
description: A backend process was inspected before the semantic hash was frozen.

name: Backend-derived responsibility
description: A responsibility was created or renamed because a backend supports a device.

name: Baseline-driven membership
description: Experimental Agent/baseline performance influenced data membership or task design.

name: Policy inadmissible
description: A policy reads inputs outside the public-observation and authorized-action interface.

name: Seed leakage
description: Search and certification seeds overlap, or a certification seed was used during search.

name: Certification optimization
description: Policy selection optimized against certification seeds.

name: Invalid opportunity threshold
description: Release thresholds violate 0 <= delta_noop < delta_positive <= 1.

name: Certificate not covering Pi_auth_pub
description: A certified-no-op claim rests on a bound covering only Pi_cert; must be boundary_opportunity.

name: Unsupported capability
description: Required capability, authorized action or public information is absent for the binding.

name: Process duplication
description: One physical process is multiplied into nominally independent primary samples.

name: Gold leakage
description: Gold actions or private witnesses are present in a public record or Contract.

name: Replay mismatch
description: Deterministic replay produced a different rollout than the preregistered fixture.

name: Quota infeasible
description: Per-split or per-stratum minimum counts are unmet; the responsibility becomes preview_only.

name: Split leakage
description: A physical or semantic connected component spans more than one split.

name: Missing required coverage
description: A responsibility field has no clause-coverage row, or a coverage row lacks adjudication.

name: Lineage break
description: A parent reference, parent hash or stage ordering in the lineage is violated.

name: Release failed closed
description: Release QA aggregate verdict when any blocking assertion fails.

name: Release not frozen
description: An object or configuration is used downstream while still provisional.

name: Freeze event
description: Explicit release event: object becomes append-only (frozen).

name: Release event
description: Object released as an executable or published artifact.

name: Versioning invalidation
description: Semantic or evaluator change invalidates a version and all downstream hashes; a new version is created.
